description: Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.

c.request: For each invoice in the invoice line items, find its average `product_quantity` and its relative gap between product cost and total cost, i.e. (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that relative gap, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages. Each invoice's cost gap is the mean of the per-line ratios (product cost − total cost) ÷ total cost.
c.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS rel_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty AS average_quantity, inv.rel_gap AS relative_cost_gap, inv.avg_qty - overall.overall_avg AS difference_above_overall_average FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY difference_above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10

a.request: For each invoice number in the invoice line items, compute the average `product_quantity` and the average over its lines of (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that cost ratio, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages.
a.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty AS average_quantity, inv.cost_ratio AS cost_ratio, inv.avg_qty - overall.overall_avg AS difference_above_overall FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY difference_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For each invoice_number in Invoice_Line_Items, compute the average of product_quantity (ignoring NULLs) and the average over its line items of the per-line ratio (derived_product_cost − derived_total_cost) ÷ derived_total_cost (ignoring NULLs); keep only invoices whose average quantity exceeds the mean of all invoices' average quantities, and return invoice_number, average quantity, that mean per-line relative gap, and the difference between the invoice's average quantity and the overall average, sorted by that difference descending (NULLs last), limited to the top 10, with no rounding
b.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_qty AS average_quantity, inv.avg_relative_gap AS mean_per_line_relative_gap, inv.avg_qty - overall.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY difference_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: For each invoice in the invoice line items, compute two things: (1) its average `product_quantity`, and (2) its relative cost gap, defined as the mean of the per-line ratios (`derived_product_cost` − `derived_total_cost`) ÷ `derived_total_cost`. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all invoices' average quantities. List the invoice number, its average quantity, its relative cost gap, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest, with missing values last, show the top 10, and don't round any values. Ignore missing values when computing averages.
d.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / derived_total_cost) AS relative_cost_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_quantity, inv.relative_cost_gap, inv.avg_quantity - overall.overall_avg AS difference_above_overall FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_quantity > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY difference_above_overall DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
